this_title: If I Go Will They Miss Me
trans_title: 如果我离开了，他们会想念我吗？
introduction: Lil' Ant is obsessed with Pegasus, the Greek mythological character, since first learning about him at school in Watts, California. He begins to notice imaginary airplane people around his home, and yearns to fly with them.
